title: Electric Blue Money Shouldn't Disappear Slide

whatItMeans: A solid saturated field and heavy centred type make the statement feel like a manifesto, and a light sub-line adds a human turn.
techniques: Faint oversized quote mark as texture
White ticket logo at the top centre

A sentence that shifts weight to emphasise the end.
